title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Starting a New Hobby 😂 ADHD Hobby Hopping #shorts
description:
ADHD hobby hopping: all in on Friday, done by Sunday.

Bought the guitar, the amp and 3 books. Played it once. It lives in the closet with the other 9 hobbies. 😂 What's in YOUR hobby graveyard? 👇

Tip: try a new hobby for free for two weeks before you buy the gear.
